title: Neighbour's aggressive or noisy dog — what to do
question: What can I do about my neighbour's aggressive or constantly barking dog in Poland?
short_answer: You can report to Straż Miejska (municipal police) or the vet inspectorate. If the dog attacked you, call 112 and file a police report.
conditions: Constant barking: first try talking to the neighbour calmly
If that fails: report to Straż Miejska — they handle noise and animal nuisance complaints
Aggressive dog not on a leash in public: call Straż Miejska immediately
Dog attacked you: call 112, seek medical help, and file a report at the nearest police station (komisariat)
Veterinary inspectorate (Inspekcja Weterynaryjna) handles animal welfare violations
Document everything: photos, videos, dates and times of incidents
exceptions: If the dog is being neglected or abused: report to Towarzystwo Opieki nad Zwierzętami (TOZ) or local animal shelter
In housing cooperatives: also report to the building administrator (zarządca/administrator)
Repeated attacks by the same dog: court can order the dog to be seized
penalties: Owner of attacking dog: civil liability for medical costs and damages
Animal neglect/cruelty: criminal liability under animal protection law
